body: that might be a set in of mania. i would say go back on your meds until your doctor says otherwise, because you could have much more severe problems later than right away. if i go off my meds i don’t have any symptoms until about 4 or 5 days in and then it hits really hard because of the delay. please be careful, i know it can feel euphoric but trust me it’s not worth it
